headline: Supreme Court protects the funding source for completing housing for 11,000 investors of "Arkada" — Finance.ua
summary: A Supreme Court decision dated 3 September 2026 addressed the renewal for 15 years of the funding source for completing housing for 11,000 investors of Arkada.
why: Unfinished housing projects leave investors exposed to delays and losses, so court rulings on funding affect developer solvency and buyer recovery.
